question:
Select the word from the sentence below, which is an antonym for the word ‘dishearten’

Many of the world’s greatest art pieces are encouraged by kings and are inspired by nature and society.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dishearten"** means to cause someone to lose determination or confidence. (हतोत्साहित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The constant criticism began to dishearten the young artist.
 
 
 
• **"Encouraged"** means to give support, confidence, or hope to someone. (प्रोत्साहित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher's praise encouraged the students to continue working hard.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'dishearten' **is **'encouraged'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Greatest** (महानतम): Of an extent, amount, or intensity considerably above the normal or average.

 
 
• **Example:** He is considered the greatest poet of his generation.
 
 
 
• **Pieces** (टुकड़े): A portion of an object or material.
 
 
• **Example: **She picked up the pieces of broken glass carefully.
 
 
 
• **Inspired** (प्रेरित): Of extraordinary quality, as if arising from some external creative impulse.
 
 
• **Example:** The inspired speech moved everyone to take action.

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
